caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic bird, specifically a dove, perched on a rounded base. The dove has a predominantly white body with blue-tinted wings and tail feathers. Its beak is brown, and the eyes are outlined in dark color. The base on which the bird is standing is also white and features a green leafy pattern along its side, with a circular green accent near the center. The composition is vertically oriented, with the bird positioned centrally, against a plain, beige background with no additional objects or decorative details.
title: Bank Pidgeon
